items.title: Capital gains tax exemption: ITAT says ‘Jodi flats’ can qualify as one house
items.summary: ITAT has ruled that 'Jodi flats' can qualify as a single house for capital gains tax exemptions. This offers key tax relief and legal clarity for buyers combining adjacent units.

items.title: India's realty investment hits Rs 57,917 crore, but affordable housing lags
items.summary: India's real estate investment reached Rs 57,917 crore, though the affordable housing segment continues to lag. It highlights overall market growth alongside persistent gaps in budget housing supply.

items.title: PE investment in Indian real estate falls 33% QoQ to USD 1.3 billion in Q3 2026
items.summary: Private equity funding in Indian real estate dropped 33% quarter-on-quarter to USD 1.3 billion in Q3 2026. This points to a short-term cooling in institutional capital entering the sector.

items.title: AT Capital plans USD 1 billion investment in Indian real estate over the next 5–7 years
items.summary: AT Capital plans to invest USD 1 billion in Indian real estate over the next 5 to 7 years. This signals strong multi-year institutional confidence and future liquidity in the market.

items.title: Home Loan: Can improving your credit score help you secure a lower interest rate? Experts explain
items.summary: Industry experts outline how improving your credit score can help secure lower interest rates on home loans. This guidance is critical for buyers looking to lower borrowing costs.

items.title: Mohali builder to hand over Zirakpur flat, pay 11% interest for delay | Hindustan Times
items.summary: A Mohali builder has been ordered to hand over a Zirakpur flat and pay 11% interest for construction delays. It underscores accountability and compensation mechanisms for aggrieved homebuyers.

items.title: BPTP’s ₹750-Crore SkyNest Sales Blitz: 150 Homes Reportedly Sold, but Discovery Park Allottees Have Taken the Project Dispute to HRERA
items.summary: BPTP's ₹750-crore SkyNest launch faces scrutiny as Discovery Park allottees take project disputes to HRERA. It serves as an important caution for buyers to verify builder compliance before investing.

items.title: GB Realty plans ₹2,500 crore Jacob & Co-branded luxury housing project in Mohali | Real Estate News
items.summary: GB Realty is planning a ₹2,500 crore Jacob & Co-branded luxury residential development in Mohali. This will introduce significant high-end housing inventory to the region.

items.title: Lucknow: Saumitra Vihar gets RERA nod, 400 plots likely in first phase | Hindustan Times
items.summary: Saumitra Vihar in Lucknow has obtained RERA approval, with 400 plots planned in its initial phase. This provides buyers and investors with approved plotted land options.

items.title: MEA Secy meets Indian diaspora in NY: NRI property disputes, consular issues discussed
items.summary: The MEA Secretary met the Indian diaspora in New York to discuss NRI property disputes and consular matters. Resolving these disputes is vital for non-resident Indians investing in Indian properties.
